asset.name: f(x) Stability Pool
asset.description: A variable fxUSD / USDC basket. The USDC leg is invested through Aave V3.

valuation.note: Share value follows the marked pool basket. Redemption terms and underlying cash access determine the exit.

observation.refresh_note: Financial observations refresh every eight hours through the canonical producer.

metrics.return_note: Total return has not been measured.

backing.note: Allocation percentages are shares of oracle-marked value, not token units or available cash. A lending receipt is a claim, not cash held by the vault.
details: Pool share supply, token balances and the native NAV formula reconcile exactly at this block.
Current Aave claim minus stored USDC accounting: 23.135883 USDC. NAV uses the current claim; this is not a measured payment or realized return.
Aggregate reservations and unencumbered cash are unknown. Reserved shares remain included in supply until burned; do not subtract them again as extra debt.

liquidity.queued_note: Request first; the measured cooldown is shown above. Unlocking does not guarantee funded delivery.
liquidity.instant_note: Uses unreserved shares and deducts the measured instant fee from each basket leg. Gas and the final swap are extra.
remaining: Caller eligibility, aggregate reservations and receiver delivery remain unverified.
The strategy must release USDC from Aave when vault cash is insufficient.
The basket includes fxUSD. Selling it to final USDC is a separate route; no complete sized cash exit was tested.

changes.title: Baseline captured; continuous alerts are not running.
changes.note: Future comparable snapshots can show allocation moves, withdrawal constraints and reward changes here.
changes.history_gap_basis: Normal history is approximately hourly. Break lines after gaps greater than three hours or an invalid observation.
changes.history_note: Available native eight-hour observations through this financial snapshot. NAV change is not total return.
